params.1273: Climb to the highest point in Lumbridge.
params.1274: Enter Lumbridge Castle and make your way to one of the staircases, either to the north or south of the castle.
params.1275: Climb the staircase to the first floor. Climb the staircase further until you reach the second floor.
params.1276: Head towards the bank and climb the ladder, right of the bank door, to reach the pinnacle of Lumbridge Castle's roof.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
